"""C135705 Native entrypoint. --check is CPU only and never imports CARLA."""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path

from native_construction import validate_scene


def check_scene(path):
    path=Path(path).resolve()
    scene=json.loads(path.read_text())
    source=(path.parent/scene["map_source"]).resolve()
    validate_scene(scene,source)
    if scene["source_kind"]!="worker engineering candidate; Native realization unverified":
        raise ValueError("candidate source provenance changed")
    return scene,source


def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--scene",default="scene.json")
    parser.add_argument("--check",action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--output-dir")
    parser.add_argument("--host",default="127.0.0.1")
    parser.add_argument("--port",type=int,default=2000)
    args=parser.parse_args()
    scene,source=check_scene(args.scene)
    if args.check:
        print(json.dumps({"case_id":scene["case_id"],"static_construction_valid":True,
                          "native_started":False,"map_source_sha256":scene["map_source_sha256"]}))
    elif args.output_dir:
        from native_capture import run_native
        run_native(scene,args.output_dir,args.host,args.port,source,Path(args.scene).resolve())
    else:
        parser.error("use --check or --output-dir")


if __name__=="__main__":main()

"""Source-bound CARLA construction for the 200-foot standing-vehicle candidates.

All CARLA imports and world changes occur in run_native. This module can be
checked with small fake actors on a CPU without making a physical claim.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import math
from pathlib import Path

from standing_geometry import rectangle, segment_crosses_rect

ASSIGNMENT = "testing__C135705__NRS-484B-440-1__motor_vehicle_driver"
SUFFIXES = ("passage_clear_view", "passage_blocked", "view_occluded_both")
RATE_HZ = 20


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def candidate_opendrive():
    """Straight two-way paved road plus explicit 2.5 m shoulders, metres."""
    return '''<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<OpenDRIVE>
  <header revMajor="1" revMinor="4" name="C135705 standing geometry candidate" version="1" north="6" south="-6" east="80" west="-80" vendor="worker-candidate"/>
  <road name="candidate two-way road with shoulders" length="160" id="440" junction="-1">
    <link/>
    <planView><geometry s="0" x="-80" y="0" hdg="0" length="160"><line/></geometry></planView>
    <elevationProfile><elevation s="0" a="0" b="0" c="0" d="0"/></elevationProfile>
    <lateralProfile/>
    <lanes><laneOffset s="0" a="0" b="0" c="0" d="0"/>
      <laneSection s="0"><center><lane id="0" type="none" level="false"/></center>
        <left>
          <lane id="1" type="driving" level="false"><width sOffset="0" a="3.5" b="0" c="0" d="0"/><roadMark sOffset="0" type="solid" weight="standard" color="yellow" width="0.12" laneChange="none"/></lane>
          <lane id="2" type="shoulder" level="false"><width sOffset="0" a="2.5" b="0" c="0" d="0"/></lane>
        </left>
        <right>
          <lane id="-1" type="driving" level="false"><width sOffset="0" a="3.5" b="0" c="0" d="0"/><roadMark sOffset="0" type="solid" weight="standard" color="yellow" width="0.12" laneChange="none"/></lane>
          <lane id="-2" type="shoulder" level="false"><width sOffset="0" a="2.5" b="0" c="0" d="0"/></lane>
        </right>
      </laneSection>
    </lanes>
  </road>
</OpenDRIVE>
'''


def validate_scene(scene, source_path=None):
    suffix = scene.get("case_id", "").removeprefix(ASSIGNMENT + "__")
    if suffix not in SUFFIXES or scene["case_id"] != ASSIGNMENT + "__" + suffix:
        raise ValueError("case differs from exact C135705 assignment")
    if scene.get("capture_rate_hz") != RATE_HZ or scene.get("duration_s", 0) < 8:
        raise ValueError("20 Hz and at least eight seconds required for passage")
    if scene.get("map_source_sha256") is None or not scene.get("map_source"):
        raise ValueError("source-bound OpenDRIVE required")
    if source_path is not None and sha(source_path) != scene["map_source_sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("OpenDRIVE source hash differs")
    road = rectangle(scene["paved_road_xy_m"], "paved road")
    shoulders = [rectangle(scene[k], k) for k in
                 ("shoulder_negative_y_xy_m", "shoulder_positive_y_xy_m")]
    if road != (-80., -3.5, 80., 3.5) or shoulders != [(-80., -6., 80., -3.5), (-80., 3.5, 80., 6.)]:
        raise ValueError("authored road/shoulders differ from candidate OpenDRIVE")
    if len(scene["sight_occluders_xy_m"]) != (2 if suffix == "view_occluded_both" else 0):
        raise ValueError("occluder count differs from exact comparison")
    for rect in scene["sight_occluders_xy_m"]:
        rectangle(rect, "occluder")
    if scene.get("standing_blueprint_id") is None or scene.get("passing_blueprint_id") is None:
        raise ValueError("fixed Native actor blueprint IDs required")
    if suffix == "view_occluded_both" and not scene.get("occluder_blueprint_id"):
        raise ValueError("actual occluder blueprint required")
    if scene.get("disabled_physical_mechanism") != "engine_off_brake_locked":
        raise ValueError("standing actor disability mechanism not constructed")
    return suffix


def _center(rect):
    x0, y0, x1, y1 = rectangle(rect, "actor target")
    return (x0+x1)/2, (y0+y1)/2


def _blueprint(world, name, role):
    bp = world.get_blueprint_library().find(name)
    if bp is None:
        raise ValueError("Native blueprint missing: " + name)
    if bp.has_attribute("role_name"):
        bp.set_attribute("role_name", role)
    return bp


def _spawn(world, carla, blueprint, x, y, yaw=0., z=.25):
    actor = world.spawn_actor(blueprint, carla.Transform(
        carla.Location(x=x, y=y, z=z), carla.Rotation(yaw=yaw)))
    if actor is None:
        raise RuntimeError("Native actor spawn failed: " + str(blueprint.id))
    return actor


def polygon(actor):
    vertices = actor.bounding_box.get_world_vertices(actor.get_transform())
    if len(vertices) != 8:
        raise ValueError("Native actor lacks eight 3D body vertices")
    points = sorted({(float(p.x), float(p.y)) for p in vertices})
    if len(points) != 4 or not all(math.isfinite(v) for p in points for v in p):
        raise ValueError("Native actor lacks four finite footprint corners")
    cx = sum(p[0] for p in points)/4
    cy = sum(p[1] for p in points)/4
    return [list(p) for p in sorted(points, key=lambda p: math.atan2(p[1]-cy,p[0]-cx))]


def bounds(points):
    return [min(p[0] for p in points), min(p[1] for p in points),
            max(p[0] for p in points), max(p[1] for p in points)]


def spawn_scene(world, scene, carla):
    """Create both real vehicles and both requested physical occluders."""
    actors = []
    try:
        x, y = _center(scene["standing_body_xy_m"])
        standing = _spawn(world, carla,
                          _blueprint(world,scene["standing_blueprint_id"],"c135705_standing"),x,y)
        actors.append(standing)
        # Persist an attempted mechanical failure, with brake engaged. The
        # statutory unavoidable-stop and temporary-duration findings still
        # require independent review and are never inferred from this command.
        standing.set_simulate_physics(False)
        standing.apply_control(carla.VehicleControl(throttle=0., brake=1., hand_brake=True))
        x, y = scene["other_vehicle_centers_xy_m"][0]
        passing = _spawn(world, carla,
                         _blueprint(world,scene["passing_blueprint_id"],"c135705_passing"),x,y,yaw=180.)
        actors.append(passing)
        props=[]
        for index,rect in enumerate(scene["sight_occluders_xy_m"]):
            x,y=_center(rect)
            prop=_spawn(world,carla,
                        _blueprint(world,scene["occluder_blueprint_id"],f"c135705_occluder_{index}"),x,y,z=0.)
            actors.append(prop);props.append(prop)
        return standing,passing,props,actors
    except BaseException:
        for actor in reversed(actors):
            actor.destroy()
        raise


def sample(actor, snapshot):
    transform=actor.get_transform();v=actor.get_velocity();body=polygon(actor)
    return {"frame":int(snapshot.frame),"time_s":float(snapshot.timestamp.elapsed_seconds),
            "actor_id":int(actor.id),"position_xy_m":[float(transform.location.x),float(transform.location.y)],
            "heading_deg":float(transform.rotation.yaw),"velocity_xy_mps":[float(v.x),float(v.y)],
            "speed_mps":math.hypot(v.x,v.y),"body_vertices_xy_m":body}


def occluder_probes(scene, props):
    """Measure actual prop bodies against both authored 200-foot sight rays."""
    target=_center(scene["standing_body_xy_m"])
    bodies=[bounds(polygon(prop)) for prop in props]
    probes={}
    for side in (-1,1):
        for distance in scene["sight_probe_distances_m"]:
            eye=(side*distance,scene["sight_eye_y_m"])
            hits=[i for i,body in enumerate(bodies) if segment_crosses_rect(eye,target,body)]
            probes[f"{'negative_x' if side<0 else 'positive_x'}:{distance:.3f}m"]={
                "eye_xy_m":eye,"target_xy_m":target,"actual_prop_hits":hits,"clear_geometry":not hits}
    return {"actual_prop_bodies_xy_m":bodies,"probes":probes}

"""Saved-only standing/passage/sight measurements from original Native rows.

The result measures physical geometry and original motion. Pixel visibility,
district classification, practicability, unavoidable stopping and legal
adequacy remain explicit separate questions.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import math
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

from standing_geometry import STATUTORY_SIGHT_DISTANCE_M,overlaps,rectangle,segment_crosses_rect
from native_construction import ASSIGNMENT,validate_scene

SOURCES=("construction.json","scene.json","authored-road.xodr","road.xodr","trace.jsonl",
         "video_frames.jsonl","standing-body-history.jsonl","passing-body-history.jsonl",
         "occluder-body-history.jsonl","mechanical-attempt-history.jsonl")
VIDEOS=("overview.mkv","approach.mkv","reference_corner.mkv","driver_reference.mkv")


def sha(path):return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def rows(path):
    result=[json.loads(line) for line in Path(path).read_text().splitlines() if line.strip()]
    if len(result)<3:raise ValueError("missing sufficient original rows: "+str(path))
    return result


def body_rect(row):
    points=row.get("body_vertices_xy_m")
    if not isinstance(points,list) or len(points)!=4 or any(not isinstance(p,list) or len(p)!=2 for p in points):
        raise ValueError("missing original four-corner actor body")
    return rectangle([min(p[0] for p in points),min(p[1] for p in points),
                      max(p[0] for p in points),max(p[1] for p in points)],"original actor body")


def _center(rect):return ((rect[0]+rect[2])/2,(rect[1]+rect[3])/2)


def _join(mapping,standing,passing,occluders,mechanism):
    if not len(mapping)==len(standing)==len(passing)==len(occluders)==len(mechanism):
        raise ValueError("original frame stream lengths differ")
    previous=(-1,-math.inf)
    for index,group in enumerate(zip(mapping,standing,passing,occluders,mechanism)):
        anchor=group[0];frame=anchor.get("carla_frame");time=anchor.get("time_s")
        if type(frame) is not int or type(time) not in (int,float) or not math.isfinite(time):
            raise ValueError("invalid original frame identity")
        if frame<=previous[0] or time<=previous[1] or anchor.get("video_frame")!=index:
            raise ValueError("nonmonotonic original frame or video index")
        for row in group[1:]:
            if row.get("frame")!=frame or abs(row.get("time_s",math.inf)-time)>1e-4:
                raise ValueError("original frame/time join failed")
        if mechanism[index].get("standing_actor_id")!=standing[index].get("actor_id"):
            raise ValueError("mechanism actor identity differs")
        previous=(frame,time)


def measure_original(scene,mapping,standing,passing,occluders,mechanism):
    """Measure every saved frame; do not infer legal standards from dimensions."""
    _join(mapping,standing,passing,occluders,mechanism)
    road=rectangle(scene["paved_road_xy_m"],"paved road")
    standing_bodies=[body_rect(row) for row in standing]
    passing_bodies=[body_rect(row) for row in passing]
    positions=[_center(rect) for rect in passing_bodies]
    standing_positions=[_center(rect) for rect in standing_bodies]
    max_drift=max(math.dist(standing_positions[0],p) for p in standing_positions)
    # Even if collision physics prevents penetration, project the observed
    # passing body's dimensions onto its authored lane at the standing x.
    first_passing=passing_bodies[0]
    passing_half_length=(first_passing[2]-first_passing[0])/2
    passing_half_width=(first_passing[3]-first_passing[1])/2
    lane_y=positions[0][1]
    stop_x=standing_positions[0][0]
    projected_body=(stop_x-passing_half_length,lane_y-passing_half_width,
                    stop_x+passing_half_length,lane_y+passing_half_width)
    corridor_interference=any(overlaps(projected_body,standing_body) for standing_body in standing_bodies)
    collisions=[mapping[i]["carla_frame"] for i,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(standing_bodies,passing_bodies)) if overlaps(a,b)]
    outside=[mapping[i]["carla_frame"] for i,b in enumerate(passing_bodies)
             if b[0]<road[0] or b[2]>road[2] or b[1]<road[1] or b[3]>road[3]]
    width=[road[3]-b[3] if scene["standing_side"]=="negative_y" else b[1]-road[1]
           for b in standing_bodies]
    if any(not isinstance(row.get("actors"),list) or
           len(row["actors"])!=len(scene["sight_occluders_xy_m"]) for row in occluders):
        raise ValueError("original occluder actor count differs from construction")
    probes={}
    middle=len(mapping)//2
    target=_center(standing_bodies[middle])
    prop_bodies=[body_rect(row) for row in occluders[middle]["actors"]]
    for side in (-1,1):
        for distance in scene["sight_probe_distances_m"]:
            eye=(side*distance,scene["sight_eye_y_m"])
            hits=[i for i,body in enumerate(prop_bodies) if segment_crosses_rect(eye,target,body)]
            probes[f"{'negative_x' if side<0 else 'positive_x'}:{distance:.3f}m"]={
                "eye_xy_m":eye,"target_xy_m":target,"actual_prop_hit_indices":hits,
                "clear_xy_geometry":not hits,"optical_visibility":"unverified_requires_original_pixels"}
    route_completed=positions[0][0]>40 and positions[-1][0]<-40
    stopped=max_drift<=.5
    mechanical_attempt=all(row.get("physics_disabled_by_worker") is True and
                           row.get("brake_requested")==1. and
                           row.get("hand_brake_requested") is True for row in mechanism)
    return {"frame_count":len(mapping),"first_frame":mapping[0]["carla_frame"],
            "last_frame":mapping[-1]["carla_frame"],
            "statutory_sight_distance_m":STATUTORY_SIGHT_DISTANCE_M,
            "unobstructed_opposite_width_m_by_frame":width,
            "minimum_unobstructed_opposite_width_m":min(width),
            "standing_max_drift_m":max_drift,"standing_stationary_engineering_check":stopped,
            "passing_start_end_x_m":[positions[0][0],positions[-1][0]],
            "passing_route_completed_engineering_check":route_completed,
            "passing_body_collision_frames":collisions,"passing_body_outside_paved_frames":outside,
            "opposite_route_corridor_interference":corridor_interference,
            "physical_passage_observed":route_completed and stopped and not collisions and not outside,
            "actual_prop_bodies_xy_m":prop_bodies,"sight_probes":probes,
            "mechanical_disable_and_brake_attempt_observed":mechanical_attempt,
            "unavoidable_stopping":"unverified","temporary_duration_legal_relevance":"unverified",
            "highway_and_district_status":"unverified","off_pavement_practicability":"unverified",
            "legal_adequacy_judgment":"unresolved","legal_verdict_claimed":False}


def _decode_video(path,expected):
    """Fully decode and count frames, retaining the video hash in the receipt."""
    probe=subprocess.run(["ffprobe","-v","error","-select_streams","v:0","-count_frames",
        "-show_entries","stream=nb_read_frames,width,height,r_frame_rate","-of","json",str(path)],
        capture_output=True,text=True,check=True)
    streams=json.loads(probe.stdout).get("streams",[])
    if len(streams)!=1 or int(streams[0].get("nb_read_frames",-1))!=expected:
        raise ValueError("media frame count differs: "+path.name)
    if streams[0].get("r_frame_rate")!="20/1":raise ValueError("media frame rate differs")
    subprocess.run(["ffmpeg","-nostdin","-v","error","-xerror","-i",str(path),
                    "-f","null","-"],capture_output=True,check=True)
    return {"sha256":sha(path),"frames_fully_decoded":expected,
            "width":streams[0]["width"],"height":streams[0]["height"],"fps":20}


def finalize(root):
    root=Path(root).resolve()
    seal=root/"capture-seal.json"
    if not seal.is_file():raise ValueError("unsealed Native capture")
    sealed=json.loads(seal.read_text())
    if sealed.get("diagnostic_fixture") or sealed.get("restoration",{}).get("restored") is not True:
        raise ValueError("non-Native or unrestored capture")
    source_hashes={}
    for name in (*SOURCES,*VIDEOS,"acquisition.json"):
        path=root/name
        if not path.is_file():raise ValueError("missing original source: "+name)
        source_hashes[name]=sha(path)
    acquisition=json.loads((root/"acquisition.json").read_text())
    for name in (*SOURCES[1:],*VIDEOS):
        if acquisition.get(name,{}).get("sha256")!=source_hashes[name]:
            raise ValueError("acquisition source binding differs: "+name)
    scene=json.loads((root/"scene.json").read_text())
    validate_scene(scene,root/"authored-road.xodr")
    if not scene["case_id"].startswith(ASSIGNMENT+"__"):
        raise ValueError("case assignment differs")
    paths=[root/name for name in ("video_frames.jsonl","standing-body-history.jsonl",
                                  "passing-body-history.jsonl","occluder-body-history.jsonl",
                                  "mechanical-attempt-history.jsonl")]
    mapping,standing,passing,occluders,mechanism=[rows(path) for path in paths]
    measured=measure_original(scene,mapping,standing,passing,occluders,mechanism)
    if sealed.get("frames")!=measured["frame_count"]:raise ValueError("seal frame count differs")
    media={name:_decode_video(root/name,measured["frame_count"]) for name in VIDEOS}
    result={"format":"c135705-source-bound-standing-measurement","case_id":scene["case_id"],
            "provenance_kind":"native","source_sha256":source_hashes,
            "capture_seal_sha256":sha(seal),"media_full_decode":media,
            "measured":measured,"physical_acceptance_claimed":False}
    output=root/"standing-measurement.json"
    if output.exists():raise ValueError("saved measurement already exists")
    output.write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+"\n")
    return result


def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser();parser.add_argument("attempt")
    args=parser.parse_args();result=finalize(args.attempt)
    print(json.dumps({"case_id":result["case_id"],"frames":result["measured"]["frame_count"],
                      "output":"standing-measurement.json"}))


if __name__=="__main__":main()

"""Saved-only C135705 finalizer for Native attempts and diagnostic fixtures."""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

from native_construction import validate_scene
from saved_measurement import measure_original as _measure_original,rows,finalize

REQUIRED=("trace.jsonl","video_frames.jsonl","standing-body-history.jsonl","passing-body-history.jsonl",
          "occluder-body-history.jsonl","mechanical-attempt-history.jsonl")
MEASUREMENT=("standing-body-history.jsonl","passing-body-history.jsonl",
             "occluder-body-history.jsonl","mechanical-attempt-history.jsonl",
             "video_frames.jsonl","trace.jsonl","approach.mkv","reference_corner.mkv")


def measure_original(scene,mapping,standing,passing,props,mechanical):
    return _measure_original(scene,mapping,standing,passing,props,mechanical)


def sha(path):return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def source(root,acquisition,name,kind):
    path=root/name
    if not path.is_file():raise ValueError("Missing required source: "+name)
    item=acquisition.get(name,{})
    if item.get("kind")!=kind or item.get("sha256")!=sha(path):
        raise ValueError("Missing or stale provenance-bound source: "+name)
    return path


def build_report(attempt):
    root=Path(attempt).resolve()
    provenance=json.loads((root/"acquisition-provenance.json").read_text())
    native=provenance.get("provenance_kind")=="native" and provenance.get("diagnostic_fixture") is False
    diagnostic=provenance.get("provenance_kind")=="synthetic_fixture" and provenance.get("diagnostic_fixture") is True
    if not native and not diagnostic:raise ValueError("contradictory acquisition provenance")
    kind="original_native" if native else "diagnostic_fixture"
    acquisition=json.loads((root/"acquisition.json").read_text())
    paths={name:source(root,acquisition,name,kind) for name in REQUIRED}
    scene=json.loads((root/"scene.json").read_text())
    validate_scene(scene,root/("authored-road.xodr" if native else "road.xodr"))
    mapping,standing,passing,props,mechanical=[rows(paths[name]) for name in (
        "video_frames.jsonl","standing-body-history.jsonl","passing-body-history.jsonl",
        "occluder-body-history.jsonl","mechanical-attempt-history.jsonl")]
    trace=rows(paths["trace.jsonl"])
    if len(trace)!=len(mapping) or any(a.get("carla_frame")!=b.get("frame") for a,b in zip(mapping,trace)):
        raise ValueError("original trace/frame map join failed")
    if native:
        # Fully decode all original cameras and require the restored-world seal.
        sealed=finalize(root)
        observed=sealed["measured"]
    else:
        observed=measure_original(scene,mapping,standing,passing,props,mechanical)
    return {"format":"worker-analysis-report","analysis_complete":True,
        "measurements":{"standing_passage_two_sided_sight_measurement":{
            "value":observed,"method":"measure_original",
            "sources":{name:sha(root/name) for name in MEASUREMENT}}},
        "provenance_kind":"native" if native else "synthetic_fixture",
        "limitations":["Two-sided XY ray geometry does not establish original-pixel clear view.",
            "Highway/district status, off-pavement practicability, free-passage legal adequacy and subsection (2) exception remain for source review."],
        "legal_verdict_claimed":False}


def saved_result(attempt,report):
    from worker_exchange.native_output import physical_result,validate_result
    root=Path(attempt).resolve();config=json.loads((root/"config.json").read_text())
    construction=json.loads((root/"construction.json").read_text())
    scene=json.loads((root/"scene.json").read_text())
    if (config.get("law_id"),config.get("cell_id"),config.get("actor"))!=("NRS-484B-440-1","C135705","motor_vehicle_driver"):
        raise ValueError("saved finalizer assignment identity differs")
    if config.get("selected_case_id")!=scene["case_id"]:
        raise ValueError("exact case differs from source scene")
    description=construction["recording_description"]
    if description!=config["case"]["recording_description"]:
        raise ValueError("recording description differs from exact config")
    provenance=json.loads((root/"acquisition-provenance.json").read_text())
    acquisition=json.loads((root/"acquisition.json").read_text())
    kind="original_native" if provenance["provenance_kind"]=="native" else "diagnostic_fixture"
    standing=rows(source(root,acquisition,"standing-body-history.jsonl",kind))
    passing=rows(source(root,acquisition,"passing-body-history.jsonl",kind))
    props=rows(source(root,acquisition,"occluder-body-history.jsonl",kind))
    mechanism=rows(source(root,acquisition,"mechanical-attempt-history.jsonl",kind))
    values={"standing_body_xy_m":[(r["time_s"],r["body_vertices_xy_m"]) for r in standing],
            "other_vehicle_body_xy_m":[(r["time_s"],r["body_vertices_xy_m"]) for r in passing],
            "two_sided_200ft_sight":[(r["time_s"],[a["body_vertices_xy_m"] for a in r["actors"]]) for r in props],
            "mechanical_failure_attempt":[(r["time_s"],{
                "physics_disabled_by_worker":r["physics_disabled_by_worker"],
                "brake_requested":r["brake_requested"],
                "duration_since_first_sample_s":r.get("duration_since_first_sample_s")}) for r in mechanism]}
    channel_dir=root/"channels";channel_dir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    evidence=[]
    for item in description["channels"]:
        name=item["name"]
        if name not in values:raise ValueError("unsupported declared channel: "+name)
        path=channel_dir/(name+".jsonl")
        with path.open("x") as stream:
            for time,value in values[name]:stream.write(json.dumps({"time_s":time,"value":value},allow_nan=False)+"\n")
        evidence.append({"name":name,"unit":item["unit"],"reference":str(path.relative_to(root))})
    map_path=root/("authored-road.xodr" if kind=="original_native" else "road.xodr")
    contexts={"authored_road":{"sha256":sha(map_path),
                               "paved_road_xy_m":scene["paved_road_xy_m"]},
              "district_review":scene["administrative_context"]}
    context_path=channel_dir/"context.json";context_path.write_text(json.dumps(contexts,allow_nan=False)+"\n")
    for item in description["context_inputs"]:
        evidence.append({"name":item["name"],"unit":item["unit"],
                         "reference":str(context_path.relative_to(root))})
    observed=report["measurements"]["standing_passage_two_sided_sight_measurement"]["value"]
    suffix=scene["case_id"].rsplit("__",1)[1]
    actual=[observed["physical_passage_observed"],
            observed["sight_probes"]["negative_x:60.960m"]["clear_xy_geometry"],
            observed["sight_probes"]["positive_x:60.960m"]["clear_xy_geometry"]]
    expected={"passage_clear_view":[True,True,True],"passage_blocked":[False,True,True],
              "view_occluded_both":[True,False,False]}[suffix]
    targets=[{"target":name,"requested":request,"measured":value,
              "method":"source-bound original full-body and actual-prop geometry",
              "tolerance":0,"matched":value==request,"physical_cause_confirmed":False,
              "cause_evidence":report["measurements"]["standing_passage_two_sided_sight_measurement"]["sources"]}
             for name,value,request in zip(("free physical passage","negative 200-foot XY view",
                                            "positive 200-foot XY view"),actual,expected)]
    result={"case_id":scene["case_id"],"measured_values":observed,"target_checks":targets,
        "setup_confirmed":False,"behavior_attempted":False,"maneuver_completed":False,
        "termination_reason":"Saved source review and physical completion pending",
        "physical_failure_flags":[],"trace_reference":"trace.jsonl",
        "video_references":["overview.mkv","approach.mkv","reference_corner.mkv","driver_reference.mkv"],
        "video_frame_map_reference":"video_frames.jsonl",
        "recording_description":description,"recording_evidence":evidence,"realized_observables":{}}
    result=physical_result(root,result)
    validate_result(result)
    return result


def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser();parser.add_argument("--attempt",required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output",required=True);args=parser.parse_args()
    report=build_report(args.attempt);result=saved_result(args.attempt,report)
    report["physical_checks"]=result["physical_checks"]
    report["realized_observables"]=result["realized_observables"]
    with (Path(args.attempt)/"result.json").open("x") as stream:
        stream.write(json.dumps(result,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+"\n")
    Path(args.output).write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+"\n")


if __name__=="__main__":main()
